crossrefs.text: O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.”
I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
And again: “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and extol Him, all you peoples.”
Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
This is the One who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ—not by water alone, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies to this, because the Spirit is the truth.
Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.

notes.title: That the Gentiles may glorify God
